gaps: P0: none. P5 has only an event view (1945 ruins); the NARA aerials #33/#34 are dated only by an uploader’s guess (‘likely around 1920’).
notes: #29/#30 are Hamburg, Pennsylvania; #16 is a Bellotto capriccio held in Hamburg; #9 is Harburg (separate town in 1654); #11 is a 1675 reissue of the 1572 Braun and Hogenberg plate; #15 is an 1828 copy. #17 (1842 panorama of the ruins after the Great Fire) is a strong general view but an event; #19 (1780 optical view of the Jungfernstieg) is a possible second P3 if wanted. P6 alternative: #36, the classic spires-across-the-Binnenalster view, but backlit and dark.
